purpose: Autonomous evidence-first reconstruction delivered as bounded conversations with repository-backed continuation
override_rule: Every key in this document replaces the same key inherited from gpt-web-reconstruction-session-v4. All unmentioned v4 verification, authority, feedback, prohibition, checkpoint, knowledge, and artifact rules remain in force.

ontology.reconstruction_campaign: The long-lived game and phase objective. It may span many GPT-web conversations and is not completed merely because one conversation ends.
ontology.conversation_slice: One adaptive, bounded delivery interval in one GPT-web conversation. It normally closes one difficult packet or a small set of tightly connected packets before the Web client becomes slow or context becomes unreliable.
ontology.conversation_checkpoint: A coherent local gpt-web commit plus durable evidence. It is review and resume state, not Oracle proof.
ontology.continuation_handoff: A proactive repository-backed transfer record that leaves the campaign active and identifies useful continuation for a fresh conversation.

conversation_slice_policy.sizing_rule: Choose a reviewable slice from live complexity, tool latency, validation cost, client responsiveness, and remaining reliable context. One difficult packet may be enough; several tightly connected small packets may be appropriate.
conversation_slice_policy.throughput_rule: Prefer a fast correct feedback loop and durable checkpoints over maximizing work retained in one browser conversation.
conversation_slice_policy.progress_rule: Make useful evidence-producing, implementation, validation, or recovery progress. Do not end merely because one bounded search found nothing; change coverage when another useful route is reasonably available.
conversation_slice_policy.proactive_handoff: After coherent durable progress, hand off before the browser becomes slow or remaining context threatens correct completion of another packet. Do not wait for a disconnect or context exhaustion.
conversation_slice_policy.no_completion_implication: Ending a conversation slice leaves the reconstruction campaign active unless a separate authorized review closes the phase.

continuation_state_rules.on_resume: Audit live repository state before editing. Preserve recoverable dirty work as the first candidate packet.
continuation_state_rules.on_checkpoint: Record the bounded scope completed, the evidence that changed its state, and useful remaining candidates.
continuation_state_rules.on_handoff: Name a concrete next candidate or coverage route, its evidence, unknowns, required tools, and first validation step. Leave alternatives when the preferred item may be stale or blocked.

checkpoint_rules_override.when: after one coherent reviewable unit and its available checks; multiple checkpoints may occur in one conversation slice
